name: Amina K.
story: I waited because I was afraid. A nurse at a Kigali clinic listened, and I started treatment. I still have hard days, but I am here.

name: Jean P.
story: I thought urine trouble was only age. My son took me to CHUK. Early checks made care possible. I talk to other men now so they do not stay silent.

name: Claire N.
story: Screening found a change before I felt sick. Treatment was scary, but the circle of women around me kept me going.

name: Eric M.
story: I ignored blood in the stool until my sister insisted. I am recovering and I want others to ask for help sooner than I did.
